newsitem.title: USA: InterCel unit inks eight roaming pacts.
newsitem.headline: InterCel unit inks eight roaming pacts.

text.p: Powertel, a Personal Communications Service (PCS) provider and wholly owned subsidiary of InterCel Inc, said Monday it made roaming agreements with eight PCS providers for undisclosed terms.

Powertel, a PCS provider, said it has agreements with Aerial Communications Inc, American Personal Communications, BellSouth Mobility, Microcell Telecommunications, Omnipoint Corp, Pacific Bell Mobile Services, Pocket Communications and Western Wireless Corp.

"This is a critical first step," said Allen Smith, president and chief executive of Powertel. "These alliances will allow us to become part of an international network of GSM providers that will compliment Powertel's markets and permit our customers to use Powertel service throughout the world."
The company said it uses the Global System for Mobile Communications, or GSM, technology for digital communications deployed in 108 countries with more than 28 million subscribers.
